00067 void LeakDCUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00068 {
00069     int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00070     float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00071     float* inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00072     float* b1Samples = inputs[Coeff].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00073     float newb1 = *b1Samples;
00074     
00075     if(newb1 != b1)
00076     {
00077         float b1_slope = (newb1 - b1) * UGen::getSlopeFactor();
00078         
00079         while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00080         {
00081             float x0 = *inputSamples++; 
00082             *outputSamples++ = y1 = x0 - x1 + b1 * y1; 
00083             x1 = x0;
00084             b1 += b1_slope;         
00085         }
00086         
00087         b1 = newb1;
00088     }
00089     else
00090     {
00091         while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00092         {
00093             float x0 = *inputSamples++; 
00094             *outputSamples++ = y1 = x0 - x1 + b1 * y1; 
00095             x1 = x0;
00096         }
00097     }
00098     
00099     y1 = zap(y1); // denormal!
00100 }
00101 
00102 void LeakDCUGenInternalK::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00103 {
00104     const int krBlockSize = UGen::getControlRateBlockSize();
00105     unsigned int blockPosition = blockID % krBlockSize;
00106     int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00107     float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00108     float* inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00109     float* b1Samples = inputs[Coeff].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00110     float newb1 = *b1Samples;
00111     
00112     int numKrSamples = blockPosition % krBlockSize;
00113     
00114     if(newb1 != b1)
00115     {
00116         float b1_slope = (newb1 - b1) * UGen::getSlopeFactor() * krBlockSize;
00117                         
00118         while(numSamplesToProcess > 0)
00119         {
00120             if(numKrSamples == 0)           
00121             {
00122                 b1 += b1_slope; 
00123                 float x0 = *inputSamples; 
00124                 value = y1 = x0 - x1 + b1 * y1; 
00125                 x1 = x0;
00126             }
00127             
00128             numKrSamples = krBlockSize - numKrSamples;
00129             
00130             blockPosition       += numKrSamples;
00131             inputSamples        += numKrSamples;
00132             
00133             while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples)
00134             {
00135                 *outputSamples++ = value;
00136                 --numSamplesToProcess;
00137                 --numKrSamples;
00138             }
00139         }
00140         
00141         b1 = newb1;
00142         
00143     }
00144     else
00145     {
00146         while(numSamplesToProcess > 0)
00147         {
00148             if(numKrSamples == 0)           
00149             {
00150                 float x0 = *inputSamples; 
00151                 value = y1 = x0 - x1 + b1 * y1; 
00152                 x1 = x0;
00153             }
00154             
00155             numKrSamples = krBlockSize - numKrSamples;
00156             
00157             blockPosition       += numKrSamples;
00158             inputSamples        += numKrSamples;
00159             
00160             while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples)
00161             {
00162                 *outputSamples++ = value;
00163                 --numSamplesToProcess;
00164                 --numKrSamples;
00165             }
00166         }
00167     }
00168     
00169     y1 = zap(y1);
00170 }

00173 {
00174     UGen inputs[] = { input, coeff };
00175     const int numInputChannels = findMaxInputChannels(numElementsInArray(inputs), inputs);      
00176     initInternal(numInputChannels);
